title: New Best Location in Scottsdale Walk to Everything
description:
We are proud to present the **The Paradise Retreat**

This property is within walking distance of some of the best grocery stores, restaurants, & shopping in the area.

Over half a million dollars was recently spent renovating this 9 bedroom 6 full bath estate that can accommodate your group with ease.

Featuring a fully fenced combo tennis/pickleball/basketball court, playground, large pool, spa, outdoor kitchen, putting green, & multiple covered patios to offer shade in the summer months.
amenities: Children’s books and toys for ages 0-2 years old and 2-5 years old
Clothing storage: walk-in closet, closet, and dresser
Coffee maker: drip coffee maker, Keurig coffee machine
Exercise equipment: free weights, stationary bike, treadmill, yoga mat, workout bench
Private hot tub - available all year, open 24 hours
Private outdoor pool - available all year, open 24 hours, heated, saltwater
review_snippets: This home is a guest favorite based on ratings, reviews, and reliability

Kristin was very kind and responsive. She provided details and information prior to our arrival, checked on us during our stay and followed up promptly to answer any questions. We REALLY enjoyed our stay. If returning, we will definitely look for Resort Style Vacation Homes-the company name is well represented and reflected.
Amazing stay! Best amenities I’ve ever had on a vacation.

This was a beautiful home, felt like we stayed at a resort ! Super big with activities to do, very clean pool, home & area in general. I would definitely recommend this to anyone & I’d go back myself ! The Host replied to me at all times & was flexible with our check in, we left satisfied & couldn’t have had a better weekend. Thank you !

Staying here was seamless, frictionless, and smooth. Everything that a rental should be is here; from communication through the space and home itself. It covers children all through older folks from the meticulous focus and detail through the quality of amenities present. Bravo and thanks for such a refreshing experience. May God Bless The Team And All Those Who Put This Place Together ♥️.  A Masterpiece!
Great stay! Loved the pool amenities and extra fridge space
Clean, well maintained property with lots to do for all ages. My family would definitely stay here again.
